item.tib: tshangs spyod bsnyen myung dang rgyun spyod gnyis kyi 'gro lugs zin tho blo yi lde mig
item.coloph: de yang tshangs spyod bsnyen gnas dang smyung gnas la gnas shing dge sbyor de dag la 'jug skabs/ 'jig rten 'khor ba'i bya las kyang mi rung shing / tshangs spyod g.yung drung sems dpa'i spyod pa sha stag dag pa'i khrims la gnas shing*/ dge sbyor gong nas gong 'phel byed dgos te/ lung las/ 'jig rten 'khor ba'i las spyod spang bar bgyi/ rgyal ba nyid kyi sku la 'khor bar bgyi/ g.yung drung sems dpa'i rjes su 'breng bar bgyi/ zhes gsungs shing bkag pa gnang ba la rjes su bzung dgos pa'i phyir/ lus ngag yid gsum tha mal du mi bzhag la/ g.yung drung sems dpa' dang tshangs spyod gong ma rnams kyi rjes su bsnyeg par bya'o/ de yang 'jug pa'i thabs zab mo 'di dag rang yang go thos kyi shes rgya chung / blo gros kyi spobs pa zhan/ lung rig kyi (gi) mig rtsa phra/ nyams rtogs kyi nor la dbul/ dug lnga'i mgo lo rgod/ mkhas par 'phrad na ngo skyeng / mang por brjod na rlung lang / tshad mar bsdeb na ngag 'dar/ gral mgor bsdad na lus rngul/ 'chad par gyur na kha lkugs/ brtsod (rtsod)par gyur na mgo 'khor/ brtsoms (rtsom) par gyur na blo rmongs/ gdong du 'phrad na ngo tsha/ lkog tu thos na snying rje/ gcig pur bsdad na kha sgam/ bshad na don mi khrol/ nyan na don mi go rgyud lung khrol ba'i nus pa shig snying tsam re mi ldan pa'i zol po kho na ba des/ 'on kyang rgyal ba'i bka' gang gnyen/ 'phags pa'i lung gang zab/ g.yung drung sems dpa'i mdzad spyod zab mo la gzhi blangs/ sprul sku go sde 'phags pa'i gter lugs dka' thub nyon mongs drung 'byin dang bsnyen gnas rab dkar gyi gzhung bsrang / blo ldan snyan rgyud dri med la gzhir bzung nas/ zag med 'ja' lus 'od skur bzhes pa'i shar rdza bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyi gsung 'bum/ rgyun spyod bcu gsum nyig zhag phrug gcig la dge sbyor 'jug tshul bstab (stabs) gcig tu bkod pa ni/ rnam mkhyen ston pa'i mdzad srol kho nar 'dug gshis la dag snang gis zur brgyan/ a mdo rnga ljon (ljongs) kyi yul grur gser zhal bzhed pa'i bon gyi shing rta chen po tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis phyag len btab pa'i dogs bsal cho ga la legs cha blangs/ mdo smad mkhas grub gnyis ldan lcang lung g.yung drung bstan rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i bsnyen smyung phan yon dang*/ lung rtogs shes rab kyis phyug pa'i sde dge'i mkhas grub lung rtogs rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i phan yon gnyis kyis smin grol rgyab skyor/ de dag gi dgongs pa'i don phyogs gcig tu bsdebs nas skal ldan blo yi tha rams bkrol ba'i sde mig gis 'jug sgo lam bar phyes nas bstan pa 'di yang / tshangs spyod bstan pa'i srog shing spyod pa mas 'dzeg gi 'jug lam/ ston pa'i mdzad 'phrin dang g.yung drung sems dpa'i mdzad spyod sha stag kho na ru dgos gal che rung / yul gru tha dag so so la/ lag len mdzad srol mi 'dra ba mang po 'dug gshis/ rang rkang tshug pa'i srol mi 'dug kyang / de la phran kyang rtog 'dzin dam pos bcing pa'i bla ru song stabs/ sngon byon tshangs spyod sems dpa'i mdzad 'phrin la spyod pa ya chal 'gro ba'i bya las kho na ma gtogs srol bzang po mi 'dug sems nas/ rang dgon la bsnyen smyung 'tshogs rten gsar sbyor zin skabs slad kyang rang rang so so nas gang dran rang chod kyis bsre bslad mi 'byung ba'i phyir du/ 'di lta bu zhig bgyis na lung la rtogs bzo'i 'gal skyon 'byung min/ shar rdza rin po che'i rgyal tshab bstan 'gro'i gar mkhan blo gros rgya mtsho la bka' 'dri zhus pas/ phyi rabs dge spyod 'phel ba'i btsas su 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur legs pa'i gsung gsang rnga bo che 'byin pa la/ bdag gis blo yi pad mtsho rab tu rgyas shing snying gi ze'u 'brur yang yang bzhad nas/ phyi rabs dge spyod 'phel ba'i thabs/ gzhan phan byang sems skya rengs kyis drangs nas/ 'di nyid byed pa po ni/ skye ba 'di nas mi yi gral du tshud tsam/ phyi mar dal 'byor stong log ma red tsam/ rgyal khams kyi khol po'i nang nas khol po/ shel skyes nang nas yang tha ru gyur ba'i/ sdom gsum gyi rjes su yid bsnyegs pa'i mi la zol po'i ming thog gte rgan tha shal/ khyi la seng ge'i ming 'thog (thog) gsang ming g.yung drung thog med rtsal lam tshe dbang bde chen snying pos/ gzhan phan byang ming 'dog pa 'gro 'dul gar gyi dbang phyug brda' sprod ming thob kun mkhyen lung rig rgya mtsho smra dbang dgyes pa'i blo ldan nam/ sa steng skyes bu mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i drin can sum ldan smon lam g.yung drung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi skyabs gur du tshud pa'i slob 'bangs g.yung drung grags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dbang gi rgyal por 'bod pa gang de la/ bu slob lha btsun g.yung drung rnam dag gis gzhan phan du yang yang bskur ngor blo tshim ngo skal du 'phral du bris pa 'dis kyang tshangs spyod bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan du gyur nas/ rgyal ba mnyam med bla ma'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/
